<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex013012025-05-2117-53-13" status="reviewed"><milestone unit="section" n="Introductory verses (1b1-1b5"/> 
        <milestone unit="section" n="v. 1"/> 
        <lg> <l>gang zhig nyes pa kun bral chos rnams la ||</l><l>ye shes spyan <choice><reg>dang</reg><orig>dang {ldan pa'}</orig></choice>  thugs rje'i gsung dbyangs kyis ||</l><l>legs 'dod skye bo don la mi slu ba'i ||</l><l>'jug yul <rs type="deity">ston pa</rs> <lb n="1b2"/> de la phyag 'tshal lo ||</l></lg>
        <note type="translation">I bow down to the one who teaches the object of engagement that is non-erroneous with regard to what is meaningful (for) people who wish well.
Thanks to the eye of wisdom with regard to the phenomena devoid of all faults and the voice of compassion.</note>

  <seg type="excerpt" xml:id="ex1301_1282023-4" status="reviewed">
<milestone unit="section" n="v. 2"/> 
       <lg><l>gang ma mthong pas srid par 'khyams gyur pa ||</l> <l>bdag la shes bya'i gnas la gnas nyid bzhin ||</l> <l>lta byed tshad ma'i myig gnyis sbyin mdzad pa'i ||</l>
            <l>rgyal mtshungs <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">bla ma rnams</rs> la phyag 'tshal lo ||</l></lg>
         <note type="translation">I bow down to the bla mas, who are like Victorious ones,
Who bestowed the two eyes of valid cognition that make one see
The nature of objects of cognition as it is
To me, who was roaming in existence because of not seing.
</note></seg>
<milestone unit="section" n="v. 3"/> 
         <seg type="excerpt" xml:id="ex13012023-07-2008-36-52" status="reviewed"> <lg><l>gang zhig dngos stobs blo yis dngos rnams la ||</l> <l>log lta'i gzhung rnams rab 'jig dngos nyid dang ||</l> <l><lb n="1b3"/> <rs type="deity">ston pa</rs>'i gsung don nges byed rigs pa'i tshul ||</l> <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3773"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3774">rnam nges</rs> mdzad pa</rs> de 'dir rgyal gyur cig ||</l></lg><note type="translation">May the one who composed the Pramāṇaviniścaya be here victorious!
(The Pramāṇaviniścaya) that destroys the traditions of mistaken views about entities by a mind (that conforms to) the force of reality, which has a method of reasoning that ascertains what is real and the meaning of the words of the teacher.
</note></seg>
        <milestone unit="section" n="v. 4"/> 
        <lg> <l>de lta'i gzhung 'di skye bo blo gros phyogs can gyis ||</l><l>
        tshig don ma bshad tshig dang don 'ga' bshad pa dang |</l> <l>log par bshad dang skabs don gzhung las 'khyams bshad kyis ||</l> <l>shes 'dod rnams kyi dus dang sgra blo gron gyur byas ||</l></lg><note type="translation">(Regarding) this text that is such, 
partially intelligent people have not explained the meaning of the words,
Or have explained some of the words and meaning, or have explained them incorrectly, or have explained the context in deviating from the text.
Because of this, the time and words and intelligence of those who wish to know have been consumed.
</note> 
  <milestone unit="section" n="v. 5"/> 
            <seg type="excerpt" xml:id="ex1301_10202023-06-285" status="reviewed"><lg><l>de dag rjes <lb n="1b4"/> zhugs dpyad la ltos myed par ||</l> <l>rnam 'jig sdud dang gzhung don gsal byed pas ||</l> <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3773">ston de</rs>'i dgongs pa bde blag nges 'gyur ba'i ||</l> <l><rs type="work" ref="db:4550" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">legs bshad bsdus pa'i ti ka</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3839">bdag </rs>gis bya ||</l></lg><note type="translation"/>I will compose a commentary that is the Summary of eloquent elucidations
Such that the intention of this teacher can be ascertained easily,
Without depending on the analysis of those who follow the former,
By including their destruction and clarifying the meaning of the text.
</seg>
      <milestone unit="section" n="v. 6"/> 
       <lg> <l>rnam bshad don gyi ro dang nus pa mi shes par ||</l> <l>grags pa'i sgra las che ba'i rlung du mngon rgyug pas ||</l> <l>gzhan zer skye bo lung brgya'i rnyog chus ngoms <lb n="1b5"/> pa bdag ||</l> <l>legs bshad bkod ma yan lag brgyad ldan 'di mi 'thung ||</l></lg><note type="translation">Because they follow, running, a wind that is bigger than renown words
Without knowing the taste and quality (or strength, nus pa) of the meaning of the explanation
Those who quench their thirst with the polluted water of the hundred instructions of people who (all) say something else
Do not drink the spring-water of the eloquent elucidations which has eight attributes (of good water).
</note>
         <milestone unit="section" n="v. 7"/> 
         <lg><l>gang dag rjod tshogs snying por mi byed kyi ||</l> <l><rs type="work">gzhung</rs> gis bstan pa'i don gzhung nges 'dod pa ||</l> <l>de dag tshig 'gas don mang rab gsal ba'i ||</l> <l>rigs bshad snying po 'di la ngo mtshar lta ||</l></lg><note type="translation">Those who do not take to heart the collections of discourses,
But hope to ascertain the meaning taught in the texts (and) the texts,
Should marvel at this (commentary) that is the essence of logical explanation,
That clarifies many meanings by means of few words.
</note>
</seg></TEI>
